label: Ponder Knight · 22M
desc: The compact model (22M parameters). Learned by studying tens of millions of positions analysed by Stockfish. No reinforcement learning.

label: Ponder Knight · 22M · RL
desc: The Knight, then trained using reinforcement learning to choose between its own variations and calculations.

label: Ponder Rook · 42M
desc: Twice the size of the Knight (42M parameters), trained on all 35 million analysed positions and on the lines Stockfish expected to follow. The strongest one.

label: Ponder Rook · 42M · RL
desc: The Rook, then trained with reinforcement learning on its own look-ahead lines and on games against Stockfish. Plays about as well as the plain Rook in our tests.
